## Testing

- [ ] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest` (includes the docs checks)
- [ ] `uv run pytest -m hub`, if Hub-related code changed

## Memory ([ADR 0001](../docs/decisions/0001-memory-system-in-repo.md))

- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` updated (done / next / open questions)
- [ ] New decision? → ADR in `docs/decisions/` and added to its index
- [ ] Learned or verified something non-obvious? → dated entry in `docs/knowledge/`
- [ ] Nothing secret, employer-related or machine-specific (that goes in `CLAUDE.local.md`)
